_comment: Every script, runner and config that walks, globs or names a package directory, and whether it already sees module roots (modules/<id>/server, modules/<id>/frontend). Gate: scripts/roots-inventory.test.mjs (npm run test:scripts); node scripts/roots-inventory.mjs --list shows the pending ones by group. A converted tool becomes root-aware (through scripts/lib/roots.mjs); then run node scripts/roots-inventory.mjs --update, which lowers pendingBudget. Never raise it.

groups.ratchets: Count, size and type ratchets that walk a package directory; their budget keys are tree paths and stay, the walk must cover every root (scripts/lib/roots.mjs walkTree).
groups.generators: Generators and their --check gates that read or write named package files, or load the app in-process (which needs the moduleRoots preload).
groups.i18n: The i18n dictionary and its tools (plan step 0.3: read the namespaces of every root).
groups.test-runners: Test runners, shards, coverage and typecheck drivers that collect files under server/ or agent-hub (plan step 0.4).
groups.codemods: Codemods and conversion tooling that take or walk package files; convert when a round next needs them.
groups.checks: Other repository gates that read named package files that can move.
groups.server-tree-tests: Whole-tree tests at the top of server/.
groups.test-kits: server/testUtils files that walk, hash or build paths of the tree (stub keys included; plan step 0.9 confirms which still need a change).
groups.ops-scripts: Ops and dev scripts that read or write tree files by a hand-computed path.
groups.build-ci: Workflows, compose files and image or dev build scripts (plan steps 0.8 and 5).
groups.configs: Linter, type-checker, bundler, coverage and test-runner configs.
